findings.quoted_text: All intellectual property rights in each Deliverable transfer to Client upon delivery.
Client may terminate this Agreement at any time, without notice and without further payment.
All intellectual property rights in each Deliverable transfer to Client upon delivery.
findings.explanation: This clause transfers ownership of the work to the client immediately upon delivery, before you have received payment, leaving you with little recourse if the client withholds final payment.
findings.suggested_change: Modify the clause to state that intellectual property rights transfer only upon receipt of full payment for the applicable Deliverable.

findings.quoted_text: Client may terminate this Agreement at any time, without notice and without further payment.
findings.explanation: This allows the client to walk away instantly without compensating you for work already performed, hours invested, or expenses incurred.
findings.suggested_change: Require a reasonable notice period and explicitly state that the client must pay for all services performed and expenses incurred up to the effective date of termination.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, I hope you are doing well. I have reviewed the agreement and would like to propose a few minor adjustments before signing: - Regarding the clause addressing intellectual property, ownership transfers immediately upon delivery before payment, which leaves no recourse if payment is withheld. I propose modifying the relevant clause to state that intellectual property rights transfer only upon receipt of full payment. - Regarding the termination clause, this allows the agreement to be ended instantly without notice or compensation for work already performed. I propose modifying the relevant clause to require a reasonable notice period and explicitly state that the client must pay for all services performed up to the effective date. Thank you for your understanding, and I look forward to moving ahead.
